_comment: The Return ending's cinematic (AW-277). Read by the game (src/ui/Cinematic.tsx) and by tools/audio/narrate.py --script, which renders public/assets/ending-return/vo-<id>.ogg. A scene's "voice" overrides the narrator's; "speaker" labels the caption; "when" picks the coda: "plain", or "covenant" for a captain with 3+ Covenant clues. "chord" is the music's chord for the scene (MIDI notes, low to high).
title: RETURN

scenes.speaker: The council
scenes.text: Captain, two million people have waited thirty years for a door home. Tonight, you carry them through it.
They gave your ship a new coat of paint, a hold full of spare probes, and a send-off from every deck of the Intrepid.

scenes.speaker: Launch control
scenes.text: Cradle is clear, Captain. Every window on the ship is lit for you. Fly safe, and come back to us.
At the mouth, the lens turned slowly against the stars, the way it had the day you found it.

scenes.speaker: Navigation
scenes.text: Drives are steady. Fold reserves holding. On your word, Captain.
There was a flash of white, and then a silence longer than any fold.

scenes.speaker: Navigation
scenes.text: Captain... I know these stars. That's the old course. We're on the road to Kepler-186.
scenes.say: Captain... I know these stars. That's the old course. We're on the road to Kepler one eight six.

scenes.text: Behind you, the lens was already fading. The Intrepid is still listening, and waiting for your return.
In the Covenant's listening room, the eldest listener watched your drive flare vanish into the lens, and closed your dossier.

scenes.speaker: The eldest listener
scenes.text: They'll wake up now. Or... we will.
